headline: Blackstone funds and Halliburton agreed to put $1 billion into VoltaGrid, a US company that builds on-site power supplies for data centers.
score_reason: Lowered from 6 to 4: this is older news first reported on 11 May 2026, re-dated 2 Oct 2026, and we found no newer update.
importance_line: The money is meant to speed up on-site power for data centers, which matters to AI builders and the companies involved, but the news is nearly five months old and its closing is not confirmed.
summary: Power Technology reported in May 2026 that VoltaGrid, which builds on-site power generation for data centers and factories, agreed to take $1 billion from funds run by Blackstone and from Halliburton, and to buy its supplier Propell Energy Technology. This is older news, first reported on 11 May 2026 and expected to close by mid-2026; we found no newer update on whether it has closed.
notes: Older news re-dated: the EnergyNow page carries a May 2026 URL. EnergyNow was blocked (HTTP 403), so the entry is written from the Power Technology article carried by Yahoo Finance (12 May 2026); source and url are Yahoo Finance's, original reporting by Power Technology. Reuters, Bloomberg and Axios also covered it on 11 May 2026. No newer update found.
